title: Ego-Syntonic
style: sophisti-pop, smooth jazz pop, female lead vocals, clinical detached vocal delivery, crisp acoustic guitar picking, warm analog synths, subtle 808 bass, digital percussion, polished modern production
lyrics:
[Intro]
[Synthesizer swells blending with rhythmic acoustic guitar picking, clean digital percussion]

[Verse 1]
Mid-twenty-twenty-three, a line on paper
Perceptive, self-possessed, under her supervision
An adaptive view of independence
No direct data, just a quiet decision

[Verse 2]
March in Bogotá, social occasions
Open, quick, and funny at the start
Then the manner cooled, the air turned clinical
Separating performance from the heart

[Chorus]
Ego-syntonic, calculated choice
Curiosity genuine beneath the noise
Separating affect from the outward role
A managed presentation in complete control

[Verse 3]
July twenty-twenty-five, the arrangement holds
Instrumental patterns, carefully managed days
Authentic attachment standing on its own
Comfortable inside the matrix of her ways

[Bridge]
Degree is finished, the job formalized
First period alone, the anchor shifted wide
Less financial weight, a different kind of status
Watching from the outside, watching from inside

[Chorus]
Ego-syntonic, calculated choice
Curiosity genuine beneath the noise
Separating affect from the outward role
A managed presentation in complete control

[Outro]
[Acoustic guitar fades out over steady synth pad and quiet electronic click]
No sign of coercion.
Adaptive and chosen.
Observation ends.
[End]
